basic_details.scholarship_name: Politecnico di Milano Merit-Based Scholarships (Platinum, Gold, Silver)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Politecnico di Milano (Milano Leonardo, Bovisa, Como, Lecco, Cremona, Mantova, Piacenza campuses)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all Master of Science programs in Engineering, Architecture, and Design taught in English.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 merit scholarships awarded across international candidates annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; dozens of Pakistani engineers and architects win Platinum, Gold, or Silver awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 academic years (covering the full Master of Science degree: 120 ECTS)

nationality_requirements: International students of all nationalities (including Pakistan) residing outside Italy
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed or completing 16 years of education (4-year Bachelor of Science/Engineering/Architecture) from an accredited university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.30 / 4.00 CGPA; competitive Platinum/Gold winners typically present 3.65+ / 4.00 CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, design, or applied sciences satisfying Polimi course prerequisites.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of undergraduate study.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience, internships, and design portfolios (for Architecture/Design) strengthen the application.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0 overall or TOEFL iBT 78 or Cambridge English B2 First/C1 Advanced.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Italian not required for English-taught programs.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Academic merit; can also be complemented with regional DSU need-based benefits if eligible.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must pay non-refundable university enrollment fee (€170) to confirm scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver (covers all administrative tuition fees of €3,898 per year; student pays only ~€170 administrative tax).

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee of €50 paid by candidate on Polimi portal.

accommodation.details: Gold tier provides free accommodation in university residences; Platinum tier provides €10,000 cash grant to arrange accommodation.

monthly_stipend.details: Platinum Scholarship: €10,000 gross per year paid in installments (~€833 / month or ~PKR 250,000 / month).
monthly_stipend.amount: Platinum: €10,000 / year; Gold: Free housing; Silver: Tuition waiver

visa_fee.details: Italian student visa fee (~€50) paid by student.

health_insurance.details: Italian National Health Service (SSN) student enrollment (~€150 to €700/year depending on regional policy) paid by student.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Atm Milan student transit pass heavily discounted (~€22/month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Politecnico di Milano (Top 10 in Europe for Engineering and Architecture).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World Rank #111 overall; Top 20 globally for Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical Engineering; World #7 for Architecture.
available_majors: Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence Systems, Automation and Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Environmental and Land Planning Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Architecture and Urban Design, Sustainable Architecture, Integrated Product Design
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Automatic consideration: All international students admitted to a Master of Science program who apply by the deadline are automatically assessed for merit scholarships.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering are highest volume; apply in early call (Semester 1, Round 1).
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Upload detailed course descriptions (syllabus) of your Pakistani bachelor's degree; Polimi evaluates syllabus matching rigorously.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Politecnico di Milano Online Services Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register for Polimi credentials, generate person code, select up to 2 Master of Science programs, and pay €50 application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Create account on Polimi portal during Call 1 (September to November) or Call 2 (January to February).
2. Upload complete official academic transcripts, degree certificate, and course descriptions.
3. Upload CV, Statement of Motivation, one Academic Recommendation Letter, and Portfolio (mandatory for Architecture/Design).
5. Admissions results and scholarship notifications released progressively by March/April.
6. If awarded scholarship, pay €170 administrative enrollment fee to accept and secure award.
7. Complete Universitaly portal pre-enrollment and apply for Italian student visa at Italian Embassy in Islamabad/Consulate in Karachi.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application; no separate scholarship form needed.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by candidate during application.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation letter detailing why you chose Politecnico di Milano, your academic background, and future engineering ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for taught MSc; course description booklet of bachelor's degree required.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard 1-2 page CV detailing academic background, projects, technical skills, and software proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions based entirely on academic evaluation of uploaded documents.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE is NOT required; English test (IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 78+) is mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: CIMEA Statement of Comparability / Verification or Declaration of Value (DOV) from Italian Embassy in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified translations into English or Italian.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official transcripts and degree certificate showing all courses, credits, and GPA
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan; CIMEA verification or DOV needed for final enrollment

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed description of all courses taken during undergraduate degree
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Stamped by your Pakistani university department or registrar
Highlighting major FYP (Final Year Project) and software tools

required_documents_checklist.specification: Statement explaining motivations for choosing the program and career goals
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: One letter per selected master's program

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letter from university professor written on official university letterhead
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped by professor from Pakistani university

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: First round (Call 1) closes late November for September 2027 intake; the majority of merit scholarships are awarded in Call 1.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (GPA, grading scale, prestige of home university)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Strictly merit-based; can apply separately for DSU need scholarship)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Politecnico di Milano Academic Evaluation Committees composed of departmental faculty boards.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic evaluation of academic transcript alignment, GPA, motivation letter, and portfolio.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 merit scholarships awarded across all tiers (Platinum, Gold, Silver)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1.5% to 2% (Extremely Competitive for Platinum; Silver more accessible)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High-ranking graduates from recognized Pakistani engineering universities (NUST, UET, GIKI, FAST, NED).
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, GIKI, UET Lahore, NED Karachi who also apply for regional DSU scholarships.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: India, Pakistan, Turkey, Iran, China, Brazil, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agencies claiming they can guarantee Polimi Platinum scholarships for large fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the official €50 application fee only on the secure Polimi portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Polimi does not work with commercial agents; apply directly on the online portal.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Enrollment administrative fee to confirm scholarship (~€170).
CIMEA verification certificate fee (~€150 to €300) or DOV expenses in Islamabad.
Living cost difference in Milan if awarded Silver (fee waiver only) or Gold (dorm only).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You cannot apply for DSU if you do not get a Polimi merit scholarship. (Fact: Admitted students who do not receive a Polimi merit scholarship can still apply for the regional Italian DSU need-based scholarship which covers full tuition + cash stipend + free cafeteria).
MYTH: You need Italian language. (Fact: All Laurea Magistrale programs listed are 100% in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Blogs often confuse Polimi merit scholarships with DSU Lombardia; they are two separate funding schemes with different deadlines.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must earn at least 30 ECTS credits in the first year to renew scholarship benefits for the second year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance on campus in Milan or territorial campuses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Credits checked in August of each year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 20 hours/week under Italian student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates can convert student visa into a 1-year job search residence permit (Permesso di Soggiorno per Ricerca Lavoro).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing to achieve minimum credit thresholds leads to loss of scholarship for the second year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programs usually results in forfeiture of the merit award.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly maximum 2 academic years; third-year extensions not funded.
